meta.title: Backend Development & Infrastructure Optimization | APalevich.Pro
meta.description: We optimize APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure to remove bottlenecks and cut costs. Senior engineers, no overhead. Based in Georgia.

hero.title: Your Backend Is Slowing You Down
hero.description: We find and fix the bottlenecks in your APIs, databases, and infrastructure that cost you performance and money. No guesswork. We trace, measure, then fix.

features.title: Where We Make the Difference
features.description: Backend performance problems rarely announce themselves. We know where to look.

cards.title: API Design & Optimization
cards.description: We refactor bloated endpoints, reduce over fetching, and cut response times without breaking contracts.

cards.title: Database Query Optimization
cards.description: Slow queries, missing indexes, N+1 problems. We find and fix them with measurable results.

cards.title: Caching Strategy
cards.description: Redis, CDN, and application layer caching done right, so you stop hitting the database unnecessarily.

cards.title: Cloud Infrastructure
cards.description: AWS, GCP, or DigitalOcean sized correctly, so you pay for what you actually use.

cards.title: Scalability Architecture
cards.description: Event queues, microservice decomposition, and horizontal scaling patterns built before you need them.

cards.title: Monitoring & Alerting
cards.description: Observability setup with actionable alerts, so your team knows about problems before users do.

approach.title: Fix First, Refactor Second
approach.description: We prioritize impact. The changes that matter most get done first.
bullets: Profile the system before touching any code
Identify the top three throughput or latency bottlenecks
Fix in order of impact, not order of preference
Validate each change with before and after metrics
Document what was changed and why for your team

cta.title: Stop Paying for Slow Infrastructure
cta.description: Share your stack and symptoms. We'll tell you where to look first.
